actuatorAuth.title: Actuator authentication (the token is the actuator-token secret)

autoRefresh.title: Allow auto-refresh
autoRefresh.description: Lets Start Auto-Refresh refresh every minute while Refresh Controls is visible. The setting alone never reads the Actuator.

snapshotInlays.title: Show snapshot hints on configuration keys and @Value
snapshotInlays.description: Marks keys found in the last snapshot as observed or redacted. Values are never shown.

refreshBudgetMs.title: Time limit per refresh (ms, 1,000–60,000)
refreshBudgetMs.description: How long one refresh of all Actuator endpoints may take.

pollAttempts.title: Auto-refresh attempts per start (1–10)
pollAttempts.description: How many refreshes one Start allows. Auto-refresh also ends after 10 minutes.
